themes_detail.label: Door/Window Damage Surge
themes_detail.summary: Complaints about broken or damaged doors and windows spiked to 27 THIS WEEK, more than double the 8-week average of 13.4 complaints per week (102% increase, z-score 3.11), suggesting either a weather event, break-ins, or building code violations affecting multiple properties in Riverdale/Fieldston.
evidence: 27 door/window complaints THIS WEEK vs. 13.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (102% spike)
Z-score of 3.11 indicates statistically significant anomaly
reporting_angles: Interview residents on whether recent storms or break-ins triggered complaints; check with NYPD precinct for burglary patterns
Contact 311 to identify geographic clusters—are complaints concentrated in one neighborhood area or building type?

themes_detail.label: Tree Health Crisis in Parks
themes_detail.summary: Dead and dying tree complaints exploded to 7 exactly 2 weeks ago, representing a 5500% spike from the 8-week baseline of 0.1 complaints per week (z-score 20.79), pointing to possible disease, pest infestation, or storm damage affecting Riverdale's tree canopy.
evidence: 7 dead/dying tree complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average (5500% increase, z-score 20.79)
Highest z-score in dataset (20.79) indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Community board has standing request for park upgrades and maintenance equipment—may indicate deferred maintenance issue
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Parks to determine cause: emerald ash borer, fungal disease, storm damage, or aging infrastructure?
Investigate whether this ties to the community board's repeated budget requests for park maintenance equipment and upgrades

themes_detail.label: Elevator Failures Spike
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints jumped to 3 LAST WEEK, a 2300% increase from the 8-week average of 0.1 complaints per week (z-score 8.69), indicating potential systemic failures in residential or public buildings across the district.
evidence: 3 elevator complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average (2300% spike, z-score 8.69)
Second-highest z-score in dataset indicates highly unusual event
High severity for mobility-dependent residents in a district with aging housing stock
reporting_angles: Identify which buildings reported elevator failures via 311 data; check DOB violation history and permit filings
Interview residents in affected buildings about wait times and impact on elderly/disabled residents

themes_detail.label: Root/Sewer Infrastructure Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Complaints about root damage, sewer issues, and sidewalk conditions jumped to 4 LAST WEEK, a 1500% increase from the 8-week baseline of 0.2 complaints per week (z-score 5.67), suggesting aging underground infrastructure failures in Riverdale.
evidence: 4 root/sewer/sidewalk complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (1500% increase, z-score 5.67)
Aligns with 926 street condition complaints over 90-day period—chronic issue with acute spike
Community board repeatedly requests street and infrastructure improvements
reporting_angles: Map the 4 complaints to identify if failures are clustered (e.g., one block or one aging water main line)
Request DEP inspection reports for the district; investigate whether recent weather or construction triggered failures

themes_detail.label: Unsanitary Encampments and Dead Animals
themes_detail.summary: Over the last 3 weeks, encampment complaints spiked 700% (4 complaints vs. 0.5 baseline, z-score 4.04), while dead animal complaints rose 400% (5 LAST WEEK vs. 1.0 baseline, z-score 5.66), indicating possible homelessness and sanitation crisis converging in Riverdale.
evidence: Encampment complaints: 4 (3 weeks ago) vs. 0.5 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 4.04)
Dead animal complaints: 5 LAST WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average (400% spike, z-score 5.66)
Community board requests housing assistance for youth leaving foster care—suggests homelessness context
reporting_angles: Locate encampments and interview residents about conditions, services available, and city response times
Investigate whether dead animals are related to encampments or indicate broader pest/sanitation issues; contact Sanitation Dept
